name: refund-agent
purpose: Decide refund requests under the written refund policy v4; escalate anything over $500 or from repeat refunders.
users: Customers via the help centre; support staff review escalations

controls.control: In the agent register with an owner, purpose and incident contact
Shadow mode against human decisions before acting, with a written promotion gate
Regression eval gate on every prompt or model change
Own identity; delegated, scoped, short-lived tokens per task
Amounts and recipients come from records, never from ticket text; refunds capped at the order total in code
Every write passes a code-level policy that checks arguments, not just tool names
Refunds over $50 need a person; unsafe actions denied; escalation after 3 denials
Traces of every model and tool call; audit log names user, agent and grant
Model id pinned; model upgrades go through the eval gate
Kill switch checked before every action; behavioural tripwires flip it

name: sales-followup-agent
purpose: Email prospects after demos with tailored follow-ups.

controls.control: Uses the sales team's shared API key
Prompt reviewed by the sales lead
